title: Chapter 1470 - 12: Joining Forces (Part 2)

Chapter 1470 - 12: Joining Forces (Part 2)

Chapter 1470: Chapter 12: Joining Forces (Part 2)

"Should we follow them?"

Lord Wan Xiang tentatively asked.

The so-called "following them" means voluntarily beginning the tribulation, accepting the challenge of preventing the Galactic Ascent on the path of transcendence.

Otherwise, they would not be guided by the will of the Supreme Rule Dao and would be unable to pinpoint Lin Yuan’s exact location.

"Let’s follow them."

"With so many terrifying existences, no matter how strong the Galaxy is, it’s impossible to resist so easily."

"Indeed, with these terrifying presences drawing the Galaxy’s attention, we shouldn’t be noticed either."

"At that time, all we need to do is blend in with them. Even if we fail, they will be the ones hunted by the Galaxy. We have a good chance of retreating unscathed. But if we succeed, it would be like overcoming a thousand tribulations, and the rewards..."

Lord Haotian, Lord Fantian, Lord of Nine Dragons, Lord Wan Xiang, and other Legendary Lords exchanged glances, finally reaching a decision in their hearts.

When the sky falls, taller ones can hold it up.

And at this moment, the terrifying entities from different spacetime continuums of the past and future are the ’tall ones’.

With them confronting the Galaxy, Lords Haotian and Fantian believed it was foolproof, and regardless of success or failure, there would be no significant loss to themselves.

...

"This feeling?" Lord Chu Wei, in seclusion, digesting gains obtained from the white jade steps, suddenly sensed a vast, terrifying aura approaching.

In the presence of this immense and terrifying aura, Lord Chu Wei felt as if he were a lone boat sailing on a vast ocean, perishing at any moment.

"What is that?"

Lord Chu Wei, as a Third Realm Time Lord, barely managed to follow the source of the terrifying aura and saw over five hundred colossal figures approaching.

These over five hundred figures gave Lord Chu Wei an overwhelming sense of oppression; any one of them far exceeded Wanwei spacetime and were pinnacle existences of limitless dimensional realms.

"Lord Haotian..... Lord Fantian?" Lord Chu Wei saw among the five hundred terrifying figures, seven or eight unassuming figures, being none other than the Legendary Lords like Lord Haotian, whom he could only look up to.

"So many terrifying existences, from different spacetimes?"

Lord Chu Wei vaguely sensed that although the aura of the five hundred figures was terrifying, it did not belong to the current spacetime.

"What exactly is happening?"

Lord Chu Wei was apprehensive; although he was a Time Lord, he had not reached the legendary level, and his exploration of the white jade steps was limited to the forefront.

He was unaware of changes higher up on the white jade steps.

As for the tribulation to block the Galactic Ascent, caused by the descent of the will of Supreme Rule Dao? Understanding this matter was limited to Legendary Lords, and Lord Chu Wei was oblivious to it.

Lord Chu Wei could already feel the source of the oppression.

As for First Realm and Second Realm time beings? They were utterly panicked, with perception ranges twisted and blurry. The Legendary Lords of three billion tribulations each had exceptionally high achievements on the path of transcendence, beyond what ordinary time beings could perceive.

Just as ants cannot see the full picture of an elephant, because it is beyond their understanding.

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with a slight frown: "Have all my true selves, including the true selves within the origin world, and my avatars been locked by the will of the Supreme Rule Dao?"

With Lin Yuan’s current level of strength, he naturally sensed that his location had been locked. Apart from a true self climbing the white jade steps, protected by transcendent power and unable to be locked, all other true selves were under the watch of the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

"I always knew the will of the Supreme Rule Dao wasn’t simple."

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

Originally, upon learning from the Purple Light Legendary Lord that he had become the tribulation of numerous Legendary Lords of billion tribulations, he planned to hide with the Chaos Void for safety, deep within layered spacetimes.

Lin Yuan even exerted the power of the "Innate Five Great" to completely isolate the entire Chaos Void from the timeline. Under these circumstances, other time beings, even those as strong as Legendary Lords, could not detect the specific location of the Chaos Void.

But now, his position was locked, and along with it, so was the Chaos Void.

As for Lin Yuan leaving? Without him holding the Chaos Void, this concealment would be incomplete and would eventually be discovered.

"Time fluctuations? Powerful Legendary Lords from different spacetimes of past and future?"

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted slightly, feeling the vast aura of time fluctuations from afar.

"I see."

Lin Yuan deduced that the real backup of the will of the Supreme Rule Dao was those pinnacle Legendary Lords from different spacetimes.

...

Chaos Void.

Lord Mo Xu and other time beings felt a shudder in their hearts. At this moment, the future timelines they were observing were entirely dark and twisted, with lines rapidly collapsing, indicating a looming great terror.

This great terror would lead to the annihilation of all future timelines, utterly unheard of, something even Lord Mo Xu and other time beings had never heard of.

"Galaxy."

"Galaxy."

Upon sensing the future timelines descending into darkness and distortion, Lord Mo Xu and other time beings immediately contacted Lin Yuan.

This situation exceeded their handling capabilities and needed to be reported to the pillar of the Chaos Void—the Galaxy Lord.

"I am already aware of this."

In front of Lord Mo Xu and other time beings, the image of Lin Yuan emerged.

"Galaxy is aware?"

"Yes, if even we sense something amiss, then surely the Galaxy has noticed too."

Lord Mo Xu and other time beings sighed slightly in relief, then curiously asked: "Galaxy, what exactly is causing this transformation of future timelines?"

Though observing future timelines by time beings occasionally results in blurring and distortion, it is impossible for them all to be so.

This implies that the future bears no vitality, descending into absolute destruction.

"It is because of me."

Lin Yuan said in a calm tone.

What Lord Mo Xu and other time beings saw as a wholly dark and blurred future originated from those Legendary Lords nearing the end of the transcendence path from different spacetimes.

So many Legendary Lords appearing at once, also involving the will of Supreme Rule Dao?

Not to mention Lord Mo Xu and other time beings, even Lin Yuan himself found it hard to observe the specific future timelines.

"Because of you, Galaxy?"

Lord Mo Xu and other time beings exchanged glances, wanting to ask but hesitating.

...

"Arrived."

"This dimensional space should be the one where the Galaxy Lord is hiding."

Outside the Chaos Void, more than five hundred terrifying existences haltered, staring at this dimensional space.

"Such a unique hiding technique, separating even from the timeline."

A terrifying existence’s gaze expressed wonder; in their sight, there was absolutely nothing here.

"Yes, if not for the guidance of the will of the Supreme Rule Dao, we wouldn’t have discovered that there was a dimensional space here? Let alone the location of the Galaxy Lord."

One by one, the terrifying existences engaged in dialogue, becoming more cautious.

Knowing the concealment methods utilized by the Galaxy Lord, even combined, they had to proceed cautiously.

These terrifying existences were from different spacetimes; even if they failed the tribulation, the loss would be limited to their main battle bodies gathered here, leaving survival means in their original spacetimes.

This time, the descent of the tribulation from the will of the Supreme Rule Dao, attracting so many terrifying existences, primarily because even if the tribulation failed, they would not be obliterated.

If this prerequisite did not exist, perhaps half the terrifying presences would have been absent.

None nearing the end of the transcendence path were fools; the numerous benefits offered by the will of Supreme Rule Dao meant that the tribulation was far from simple.

Buzzing~ Just after the five hundred terrifying existences arrived at the Chaos Void.

The massive Chaos Void gradually manifested, a young man appearing outside the Chaos Void, facing the terrifying presences alone.

"Galaxy Lord."

The leading terrifying existence radiated boundless brilliance, smiling at Lin Yuan: "This time, we’ve come to have a discussion with you, Galaxy Lord."
